subject: economics
objective: What compound growth rate does this series imply?
instruction: Greenfield's output grew but its population grew faster: Real output was USD 640,000,000 at the start and USD 701,000,000 at the end of a span of 7 year(s), while the population went from 5,000,000 to 5,900,000. Use compound (geometric) annual rates: g = (end / start)^(1/periods) - 1, applied separately to output, to population and to output per person. Periods are years. Required: total growth rate, average annual growth rate, population growth rate, per capita start, per capita end, per capita annual growth rate, growth gap.
